## pcornet_7_0

Version **7.0** · 28 tables · 133 bounded valuesets.

| Table | Composite key | Fields | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `demographic` | `PATID` | 24 | Demographics record the direct attributes of individual patients. |
| `provider` | `PROVIDERID` | 6 | Data about the providers who are involved in the care processes documented in the CDM. |
| `harvest` | `NETWORKID`, `DATAMARTID` | 60 | Attributes associated with the specific PCORnet datamart implementation, including data refreshes. |
| `encounter` | `ENCOUNTERID` | 31 | Encounters are interactions between patients and providers within the context of healthcare delivery. |
| `diagnosis` | `DIAGNOSISID` | 18 | Diagnosis codes indicate the results of diagnostic processes and medical coding within healthcare delivery. Data in this table are expected to be from healthcare-mediated processes and reimbursement drivers. |
| `procedures` | `PROCEDURESID` | 14 | Procedure codes indicate the discreet medical interventions and diagnostic testing, such as surgical procedures and lab orders, delivered within a healthcare context. |
| `vital` | `VITALID` | 21 | Vital signs (such as height, weight, and blood pressure) directly measure an individual’s current state of attributes. |
| `dispensing` | `DISPENSINGID` | 15 | Prescriptions filled through a community, mail-order or hospital pharmacy. Outpatient dispensing may not be directly captured within healthcare systems. |
| `lab_result_cm` | `LAB_RESULT_CM_ID` | 33 | This table is used to store quantitative and qualitative measurements from blood and other body specimens. |
| `prescribing` | `PRESCRIBINGID` | 30 | Provider orders for medication dispensing and/or administration. These orders may take place in any setting, including the inpatient or outpatient basis. |
| `condition` | `CONDITIONID` | 14 | A condition represents a patient’s diagnosed and self-reported health conditions and diseases. The patient’s medical history and current state may both be represented. |
| `pro_cm` | `PRO_CM_ID` | 18 | This table is used to store responses to patient-reported outcome measures (PROs), surveys, and questionnaires. This table can be used to store item-level responses as well as the overall score for each measure. |
| `med_admin` | `MEDADMINID` | 20 | Records of medications administered to patients by healthcare providers. These administrations may take place in any setting, including inpatient, outpatient or home health encounters. |
| `obs_clin` | `OBSCLINID` | 24 | Standardized qualitative and quantitative clinical observations about a patient, including vital signs. Some observations may also be represented in the VITAL table |
| `obs_gen` | `OBSGENID` | 24 | Table to store everything else. |
| `death` | `PATID`, `DEATH_SOURCE` | 5 | Reported mortality information for patients. |
| `death_cause` | `PATID`, `DEATH_CAUSE`, `DEATH_CAUSE_CODE`, `DEATH_CAUSE_TYPE`, `DEATH_CAUSE_SOURCE` | 6 | The individual causes associated with a reported death. |
| `lds_address_history` | `ADDRESSID` | 16 | Longitudinal record of a patient’s address that adheres to the requirements of a Limited Data Set. |
| `immunization` | `IMMUNIZATIONID` | 29 | Records of immunizations that have been delivered within the health system as well as reports of those administered elsewhere. |
| `hash_token` | `PATID`, `TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY` | 34 | Encrypted hash tokens that are used to match patient records across DataMarts using privacy-preserving record linkage methods. |
| `original_hash_token` | `PATID`, `TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY` | 34 | Legacy-Ovid-only table: the partner's raw (pre-Datavant-transform) hash tokens, same fields as HASH_TOKEN (legacy 2026-08-31 original_hash_token). |
| `enrollment` | `PATID`, `ENR_START_DATE`, `ENR_BASIS` | 5 | Enrollment is a concept that defines a period of time during which a person is expected to have complete data capture. This concept is often insurance-based, but other methods of defining enrollment are possible. |
| `external_meds` | `EXTMEDID` | 19 | Medications external to the originating health system. Examples include medications as reported by the patient and those obtained from external health systems. |
| `lab_history` | `LABHISTORYID` | 17 | Table for storing historical information about units of measure and reference ranges for laboratory test results. |
| `private_address_history` |  | 19 | Supplemented from pcornet_cdm_v70.csv. |
| `private_address_geocode` |  | 16 | Supplemented from pcornet_cdm_v70.csv. |
| `pat_relationship` | `PATID_1`, `PATID_2`, `RELATIONSHIP_TYPE` | 5 | This table is used to store information about the relationships between patients within a given PCORnet® Common Data Model. |
| `pcornet_trial` | `PATID`, `TRIALID`, `PARTICIPANTID` | 8 | Patients who are enrolled in PCORnet clinical trials and PCORnet studies. |

## Clinical vocabularies

Bounded CDM valuesets are also registered automatically as vocabularies named `<cdm>.<table>.<column>`.

| Vocabulary | Version | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icd10cm` | OMOP 5.3 slice | International Classification of Diseases, 10th revision, Clinical Modification (ICD-10-CM), sliced from the OMOP CONCEPT bundle where `vocabulary_id = 'ICD10CM'`. Generated by `ovid2 tools import-vocabulary`. |
| `icd9cm` | OMOP 5.3 slice | International Classification of Diseases, 9th revision, Clinical Modification (ICD-9-CM), sliced from the OMOP CONCEPT bundle where `vocabulary_id = 'ICD9CM'`. Retained for legacy claims data. Generated by `ovid2 tools import-vocabulary`. |
| `loinc` | OMOP 5.3 slice | Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC), sliced from the OMOP CONCEPT bundle where `vocabulary_id = 'LOINC'`. Codes are the standard LOINC identifiers (e.g. `2951-2`); labels are LOINC fully-specified names. Generated by `ovid2 tools import-vocabulary`. |
| `ndc` | OMOP 5.3 slice | U.S. National Drug Code (NDC) directory, sliced from the OMOP CONCEPT bundle where `vocabulary_id = 'NDC'`. Codes are 11-digit NDCs (5-4-2 pattern). Generated by `ovid2 tools import-vocabulary`. |
| `omop_concept` | 5.3 | OMOP Standardized Vocabularies CONCEPT table. Provides concept_id, concept_code, concept_name, vocabulary_id, domain_id, concept_class_id for every clinical code the OMOP vocabulary bundle covers (SNOMED, LOINC, ICD10CM, ICD9CM, RxNorm, NDC, and 60+ others). |
| `rxnorm` | OMOP 5.3 slice | RxNorm normalised naming system for clinical drugs, sliced from the OMOP CONCEPT bundle where `vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'`. Codes are RxNorm Concept Unique Identifiers (RxCUIs). Generated by `ovid2 tools import-vocabulary`. |
| `snomed` | OMOP 5.3 slice | SNOMED Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT), sliced from the OMOP CONCEPT bundle where `vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED'`. Codes are SNOMED concept identifiers; labels are the fully-specified names. Generated by `ovid2 tools import-vocabulary`. |
